verdicts.line: You hold a white flame that lights only the stone around you.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: You wake in a dark cave holding a white flame that lights only the stone around you.
verdicts.reason: Direct instrumentation from the tutorial sequence — names the flame's current mechanical state (white, limited radius) without mythology.

verdicts.line: The flame in your hand is white and undetermined.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: The white flame is genuinely undetermined
verdicts.reason: Uses 'undetermined' as abstract descriptor rather than stating the mechanical consequence that makes it undetermined in uhta's system.
verdicts.correction: The white flame becomes whatever you do with it.

verdicts.line: A white flame — what it becomes is not yet decided.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: The white flame is genuinely undetermined
verdicts.reason: Speaks about future possibility ('not yet decided') rather than naming the verb-consequence relationship the tutorial demands.
verdicts.correction: The white flame takes the color of what you do.

verdicts.line: You carry a flame that has no color of its own.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: The flame in your hand is your alignment
verdicts.reason: Describes what the flame lacks rather than the mechanical consequence — no verb, no stated outcome.
verdicts.correction: The flame in your hand is white — your actions will color it.

verdicts.line: The white flame waits — it will become whatever you do with it.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: a white flame that becomes whatever you do with it
verdicts.reason: States the verb-consequence relationship directly — action determines alignment, the core mechanic of the flame system.

verdicts.line: In your hand: a flame, white, holding no feeling yet.
verdicts.reason: The colon construction and 'holding no feeling yet' is descriptive mood rather than declarative instrumentation.
verdicts.correction: The white flame holds no feeling — it will take yours.

verdicts.line: The flame is yours, white and empty of intent.
verdicts.reason: 'Empty of intent' is abstract characterization; no verb named, no consequence stated.
verdicts.correction: The flame is white — where you walk, what you do, it remembers.

verdicts.line: You wake holding white fire — neither path is written into it.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: Before you are two paths — and like the prisoners in Plato's cave, you first encounter Hope and Fear only as shadows. One is lit red — its walls show shadows fighting, killing, screaming. The other is lit green
verdicts.reason: Names the mechanical state (white fire, neither path written in) and ties directly to the two-path choice that tints the flame.
